spans.s:
1 क॑ stem of the interr. pron. (n. क॑द् older than कि॑म्
q.v.) who, what, which? Used as subst. or adj. in direct & indirect
questions, often connected w. इव, उ, नाम, नु, वा, स्विद्, also w. a
demonstr. pron., e.g. को ऽ यमायाति who comes here? किमिदं कुरुषे
what are you doing there? Used also as indef. pron. = some, any,
whoever, whatever, whichever, esp. after य & मा, before च, चन,
चिद्, & (later) अपि;
 कश्च, कश्चन, etc. w. neg. = nobody, none, n.
nothing. कश्चित्-कश्चित् the one—the other;
 pl. some-others.
